data.why: The app has a CSV import (importDoseResponseCSV) expecting Study/Dose/Effect(+CI) columns, and the README names an alcohol_cvd dose-response dataset used for validation, but no such CSV ships in the repo, so a synthetic one matching that study/exposure was written for upload.

goals: Import a set of dose-level study effect estimates and fit linear, Emax, spline and fractional polynomial dose-response curves
Compare candidate models by AIC/BIC and view AIC-weighted model-averaged predictions
Reconstruct within-study covariance across correlated dose contrasts (Greenland-Longnecker) and fit a GLS dose-response model
Estimate dose-finding metrics such as ED50, ED90, minimum effective dose and therapeutic window from the fitted curve
Check publication bias via a dose-arm funnel plot and Egger-style regression, and run leave-one-out sensitivity analysis
Run the inline self-test suite in the browser console to confirm the statistical engine matches R dosresmeta2 reference values

review.summary: The tree captures the tool's core well: fitting many dose-response models with AIC comparison, model averaging, one-stage mixed effects, dose-finding metrics, bias and leave-one-out checks, and auto-drafting, and nearly every cited screen checks out. It needs fixes before filing: one wrong screen citation (t21), a false 'no credible intervals' claim, missing breakpoint/bootstrap and Search/Screen stages, phases out of order, and an oversized extraction feature.
